notes.title: The Territory of Egg 2 —— Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028523/a927c3350568ab11ed57caa2583a5ad267acd4fd.gif
We’re thrilled to announce that The Territory of Egg 2 will attend the Steam Next Fest, and the demo is now available! Join the Egg Kingdom today and experience this upgraded tower defense game.

About The Territory of Egg 2

As a unique variant of tower defense, The Territory of Egg 2 takes you into a randomly generated forest world. Lead the Egg Warriors to light up the dark forests, build defenses, awaken the spirits of ancient heroes, and battle lurking enemies by combining skill branches and evolutions.

We’ve listened to valuable feedback from the first game, The Territory of Egg, and have made significant upgrades in The Territory of Egg 2:

 New Strategy Gameplay: Introducing powerful Heroic Eggs, more new skills, and enemy types to greatly enhance strategic depth!
 Art Optimizations: We’ve partnered with a professional art director to deliver a more immersive visual experience.
 More Levels and Challenges: The sequel offers more new levels than the first game, with various difficulty modes for you to tackle.


Game Features

 Heroic Eggs Join the Battle: In addition to basic and advanced Eggs, you can awaken 6 Heroic Eggs with unique abilities to fortify your defenses.
 Evolution Choices: Choose from 4 evolution paths for each Egg Warrior based on terrain and enemy traits to devise the perfect strategy.
 Skill Combos and Custom Builds: Both advanced and Heroic Eggs offer a wide range of skills. Mix and match to create your own powerful battle lineup.
 Resource Collection and Tech Tree Upgrades: Collect resources during battles to unlock your tech tree and make the Egg family stronger.
 Unlock Challenge Modes: As you progress through campaigns, unlock tougher challenge modes and explore the dark forest to expand the Egg Kingdom’s territory!


The Territory of Egg 2 will officially launch on October 30st. Download the The Territory of Egg 2 demo now to experience all these exciting new features! Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2863780/_2/

notes.title: Demo Available Now - The Territory of Egg 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are glad to announce that our Demo is available now! Feel fre to try it now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2863780/_2/


After the release of The Territory of Egg, we received a lot of feedbacks. In The Territory of Egg 2, I have incorporated this feedback to upgrade the game. 

 Gameplay: Introducing powerful Heroic Eggs, more new skills, and new enemies.
 Arts: Improving the visual effect, making the gaming experience more comfortable.
 Contents: The Territory of Egg 2 features even more new levels than the TTE1, with each level offering multiple difficulty modes for players to challenge.
I hope these changes will provide a better experience, and I look forward to receiving more suggestions and feedback from you.
